details.publicNotes:
When woodplucks need to work together, they gather into large groups called choruses. They typically form choruses to share ideas and collaborate on large projects, such as those inspired by a woodpluck elder's boundless creativity. They also form choruses to defend themselves against threats. Together, they can create wooden devices to climb, swim, or even fly, defend each other from harm, and launch coordinated attacks.

Choruses are loud and vibrant groups. Instead of taking turns when speaking, members of a chorus share their ideas as soon as they come to mind. By varying their pitch and volume, woodplucks make their voices stand out from the wall of sound. While woodplucks have no trouble understanding multiple ideas being spoken at once, most other ancestries have considerable difficulty making sense of a chorus' speech.

Woodplucks are plump fey creatures with a single arm protruding from their torsos. Their eager imaginations manifest in physical form through a small plant sprout embedded in each individual's head, which grows and shapes itself into whatever the host woodpluck is thinking about at the time. When a woodpluck sleeps, their sprout's roots dig into their mind and grow out into the most vivid scenes of their dreams.

Woodplucks can gather in choruses to work together, and when their imagination grows, they can become powerful elders.

Gadgets and Gizmos

To outsiders, the inventions of a woodpluck chorus seem to accomplish their goals in the most complex way possible. Since every member of the chorus is eager to add their own twist to the project, woodpluck devices usually include scores of seemingly useless widgets and thingamajigs. Nevertheless, these gadgets work—although any effort to replicate a woodpluck invention by non-woodplucks usually results in failure.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 45/100/180 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (piercing, slashing), armor (medium), skill items (Acrobatics, Crafting, Diplomacy, Performance)

Eligible Imbued Properties body, bane, charisma, constitution, dexterity, energy resistant (vitality), mind, mind shield, sensory (low-light vision), tangle shield, throwing, wild, winged, wisdom, wood

description.value: The individual creatures in a woodpluck chorus are Small. Unlike most swarms, they can't share their space with other creatures, and they aren't immune to precision damage or resistant to physical damage.

The woodplucks cultivate javelins and then throw them as a volley. This volley is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 30 feet that deals @Damage[4d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).

The woodpluck chorus collectively imagines components of a large project they then quickly assemble as needed, granting one of the following benefits of their choice. This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until the woodpluck chorus uses this ability again.

  • A climb, swim, or fly Speed of 20 feet.
  • Wooden Flurry and Cultivated Volley also deal 1d6 persistent bleed damage.
  • Access to the @UUID[Compendium.battlezoo-bestiary-es-pf2e.sf2e-effects.Item.TUvwJ1PcwOVRuHFR]{Cultivated Party} action.

The woodplucks lash out with cultivated weapons at each foe within 5 feet, dealing @Damage[(1d6+3)[piercing]] or @Damage[(1d6+3)[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). The chorus can independently choose whether the damage is piercing or slashing for each foe.
